text: Thank you for closing Members' Week 2026 with us! We appreciate everyone who joined the AAK Members Forum on Friday at Blue Violets Plaza. A huge gratitude to our moderator Plan. Christine Muchiri and speakers Eng. Nashon Tambo, ID Abigael Osidiana, Arch. Sharon Njiru and Humphrey Mumita for the invaluable insights on winning your first clients.

text: Happy Mazingira Day! The Architectural Association of Kenya is integrating professional design and environmental stewardship to create better learning environments in public schools across Kenya. Scan the QR code or visit schools.aak.or.ke to learn more.
